Excalidraw — external workflow

v0.2.36 ships a bridge to excalidraw.com. Fully self-hosted Excalidraw is queued for v0.2.37.

1Draw your diagram

Click below to open the upstream Excalidraw editor in a new tab. The launcher created an empty file on disk for you at:

—

Open excalidraw.com →

2Export as .excalidraw

In excalidraw.com, use the menu (☰) → Save to… → Excalidraw file (.excalidraw). Choose a temporary location like your Downloads folder.

3Drag into the launcher

Return to the launcher window. In the Diagrams tab, drag the exported .excalidraw file onto the drop zone (the dashed-outline area in the diagrams list). The launcher reads the file content, prompts you for a name + category, and saves it into .claude/diagrams/<category>/<name>.excalidraw.

You can close this browser tab once the import is done.

Why this round-trip? Excalidraw ships as a React app with several runtime peer-dependencies (react, jotai, radix-ui, etc.). Vendoring the full standalone build is queued for a future release. Until then, the upstream-hosted editor + drag-import is the pragmatic v0.2.36 workflow. The embedded editor we used to ship (Excalidraw inside the Tauri WebView) rendered as broken giant-icons garbage on Wayland + webkit2gtk, so it was removed.
